title: A worker's brief tells it to record a gate whenever its change departs from an answered gate or the epic's design notes
goal: the fixed rules of every worker brief (`backlog.py brief`) tell the worker to record a gate before it lands a change that departs from an answered gate of its item, an ancestor's gate or the design notes of its epic, never to report the departure only in its final message

run:
import re,subprocess,sys
o=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'_tools/backlog.py','brief','ST-p4rvgmb6'],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout
s=o.split('## Fixed rules',1)[1].split('\n## ',1)[0] if '## Fixed rules' in o else ''
sys.exit(0 if re.search(r'answered gate',s,re.I) and re.search(r'design notes|epic',s,re.I) else 1)
